channels.content_instructions: Documented unsolved mysteries; curiosity-driven Shorts. Strong hook in first 3 seconds; around 80 words and 40 seconds; simple storytelling. Distinguish known facts from theories and unresolved questions; label speculation and folklore explicitly. Never invent evidence, quotes or a definitive solution. Keep titles and descriptions faithful to the script.

channels.topic_theme: forgotten history, unusual historical incidents, strange moments from history
channels.content_instructions: Factual, concise, curiosity-driven historical storytelling. Focus on lesser-known real historical events and unusual incidents. Avoid sensational claims that are not historically supportable.
